name: Trading 212 Import
description: Pulls filled orders from your Trading 212 account and imports them into Wealthfolio as BUY/SELL activities.
author: Lev Kargalov

permissions.purpose: Read your order history from live.trading212.com. Only GET requests are made; the addon never places or cancels orders.
Keep your Trading 212 API key and secret in the OS keyring instead of in the addon bundle.
Let you pick which Wealthfolio account the imported trades belong to.
Validate the mapped trades as a preview, then write them once you confirm.
